mapper.sql: r.store_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_ops_report_store rs WHERE rs.report_id = r.id)
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.report_date, r.scope_key, r.scope_name, r.store_count, r.source, r.orders, r.sales, r.profit, r.sales_change, r.profit_change, r.abnormal_count, r.bad_review_count, r.stock_risk_count, r.ad_alert_count, r.todo_count, r.summary, r.ai_status, r.ai_sample, r.push_count, r.pushed_time, r.create_by, u.nickname AS create_by_name, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM ecom_ops_report r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by WHERE AND r.report_date >= #{begin} AND r.report_date <= #{end} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_ops_report_store x WHERE x.report_id = r.id AND x.store_id = #{storeId}) ORDER BY r.report_date DESC, r.id DESC
